game: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
sourceWorkbook: Twilight Princess Entrance Randomizer Location List [Coupled].xlsx
notes: This file contains location cards and entrance handles only. It intentionally contains no active/randomized graph connections.
Entrance types use the six shuffled categories named on the workbook Intro sheet.
For one-way entrances, direction is 'out' on the source handle and 'in' on the arrival handle. All other handles use direction 'both'.

Location grouping is normalized from spreadsheet labels. Obvious multi-entrance interiors such as Coro's House, Jaggle's House, Elde Inn, Barnes Shop, and dungeon boss rooms are grouped into one card.
Workbook naming duplicates/aliases were normalized where they clearly described the same physical transition; source labels and rows are retained for review.
Active/randomized graph connections are intentionally not included.
Entrance type 'dungeons' covers dungeon entrances and Hyrule Castle entrances.
Hyrule Castle carries specialFlags: ['hyrule-castle'] for tracker-specific handling.
Sub-areas reachable without a shuffled transition may be represented as part of a larger location card.
